frequency_question: What proportion of major contested immigration/visa fee rulemakings successfully finalize within roughly a one-year window?
membership_rule: Includes major Department of Homeland Security / USCIS fee schedule or visa program structural rulemakings that faced significant public contention or legal challenge. Excludes routine annual adjustments or minor technical corrections.
coverage_note: 6 named major contested immigration rulemakings; believed to represent the primary population of comparable high-salience structural fee rules in recent decades.
known_gaps: Excludes minor adjustments and rules that remained perpetually at the proposed stage outside normal administrative timelines.
validity_reason: Administrative procedures act timelines and executive agency rulemaking velocity remain stable across multiple presidential administrations over this horizon.
